text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The all-party National Council opts for mild response to the deal for the partial integration of Turkish occupied northern Cyprus with Turkey.
- Turkey submits a ruling to the United Nations from a British constitutional expert claiming Cyprus cannot become a member of the European Union before Turkey does.
- Five British soldiers from Dhekelia military base plead not guilty to charges of assaulting a group of British tourists in Larnaca at the weekend.
- Socialist party Edek decided to back its veteran leader Vassos Lyssarides as a candidate during the 1998 presidential elections.
- The National Council strongly condemns the "Association Council" between the north and Turkey.
- Nicosia lodges a strong protest with the permanent five members of the U.N. Security Council over the partial integration agreement between the north and Turkey.
- Cyprus wants a discussion about the substance of the Cyprus issue at Monetreux.
- Unemployment is expected to reach 3.6 percent by the end of 1997, compared to 2.6 percent at end 1996.
